name: pending-with-hash
recorded: 2026-09-12, hand-built from x402-specification-v2.md §5.3.2 (SettleResponse fields) and §9 (settlement_pending); no live door, no hostname
why: THE NEGATIVE CONTROL. success false with errorReason settlement_pending and a broadcast hash. §9 makes this code non-terminal: the transaction may still confirm. A reader that maps success:false to failed will re-challenge a buyer whose money is on its way — the seven-of-ten defect the spec thread measured. Every check passes; the reading is unresolved, never failed.
